system_prompt:
You are taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in the eighth grade. Answer each question as well as you can.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
[Image: Front of a building with a car parked outside]

The car is 3.5 m long. About how long is the building?

Figure, described in words:
A line drawing showing the front facade of a single-story building. In the center is a double door with an arched window above it. Symmetrically flanking the doors are six identical rectangular windows with multipaned sashes: three windows to the left of the door and three to the right. Parked on the ground along the far left of the building facade is a black car, positioned spanning the space of roughly the first two windows. The length of the entire building is approximately four times the length of the car.

A. 18 m
B. 14 m
C. 10 m
D. 4 m

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
answer.title: Answer
